subject: Sentinel — Operational summit: customer update on error spike & throughput constraints
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sentinel.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sentinel Ops <ops@sentinel.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: High error rate + degraded throughput impacting inference during batch jobs

Monica / Rachel —

We started seeing a sharp increase in 5xx error rates around 08:40 PT this morning when running our nightly batch scoring. Error rate peaked at ~18% and throughput dropped ~45% compared to the baseline. Latency for individual requests also spiked and caused our downstream pipelines to pile up.

Attached a short metrics slice (metrics_slices_may09.csv) showing the spike window and some example request IDs. We classified the impact as P1 because it materially affects our customer-facing scoring SLA.

Can you confirm receipt and let us know the expected ETA for mitigation? We have an internal all-hands at 10:30 PT and would like a customer-facing status draft to share.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of ML Ops, Sentinel.ai

attachments: metrics_slices_may09.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sentinel.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + degraded throughput impacting inference during batch jobs

Alex —

Received. Thank you for the data. I'm standing up an operational summit now and looping in Marcus (serving runtime lead) and Laura for executive visibility. Initial ask: Marcus, can you confirm whether this looks like a routing/backpressure issue or a model runtime regression? We will also pull logs for the GPU pools serving sentinel models and check autoscaling events.

I'll draft a short customer-facing status and share for sign-off. Proposed cadence: 10:00 PT internal sync, 10:30 PT cross-org readout with Sentinel.

Attached: hotfix_plan_v1.pdf (initial mitigation options) — this is a rapid checklist: scale routing fallback, temporarily reduce batch size for affected routes, and enable aggressive KV cache warming.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0127

attachments: hotfix_plan_v1.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + degraded throughput impacting inference during batch jobs

Monica / team —

Quick read on early telemetry: the error signatures look like transient OOMs in the latest quantized inference path on our 2nd gen pool. We see a surge in sequence-length variance around the spike window which likely triggered kernel fallback and higher memory pressure. Autoscaler did attempt to add capacity but backpressure caused queue growth faster than new workers could warm up.

Immediate actions (I have ENG on this):
- Roll back to the previous kernel selection for the affected model variant (10 min).
- Pin routing to the pre-quantized variant for high-throughput routes (5–15 min).
- Throttle batch sizes for midnight batch window and enable prefix cache warming (now).

I'll also create a short runbook note and push a patch to kernel-selector. ETA for rollback + verification ~35–45 minutes. Will update the channel once confirmed.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + degraded throughput impacting inference during batch jobs

Team —

Thanks for the quick triage. Two asks for the customer-facing status:
1) Keep the initial message short and specific: impact, immediate mitigation in progress, and expected ETA for full remediation. Avoid technical blame.
2) Include an explicit escalation point and next update time (e.g., 11:00 PT).

Monica — please prepare the note and run it by me before you send to Sentinel. Marcus — appreciate the rollback ETA; flag if you need any exec assistance to accelerate.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sentinel.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@sentinel.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Sentinel — Short status update (May 9)

Alex / Priya —

Thank you for flagging the issue. Short status (for your internal all-hands):

Impact: Between ~08:40–09:10 PT we observed an elevated 5xx error rate (peak ~18%) and a ~45% reduction in throughput for batch scoring jobs that use the sentinel-inference model. Some downstream pipelines experienced queuing and delayed completion.

What we're doing: Our eng team has rolled back the recent kernel selection for the quantized path and pinned routing to the stable model variant for high-throughput lanes. We've also throttled batch sizes for the midnight window and enabled KV cache warming to reduce cold-start pressure. Full mitigation verification is in progress.

ETA: Marcus estimates rollback + verification within 45 minutes from now (~11:00 PT). We will provide a follow-up update by 11:00 PT with confirmation or next steps.

Escalation contacts:
- Monica Patel, Redwood (primary) — monica.patel@redwood.com
- Marcus Lin, Redwood (runtime lead) — marcus.lin@redwood.com

Please let us know if you want a short joint bridge with our eng leads; we can stand up a brief (15–20 minute) call.

Best,
Monica Patel
Sr. Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
